name: Context Workspace Engine
description: Agent-managed context for long-horizon tasks: HIDE, ABSTRACT, RECALL actions with living state and archive.

summarizerModel.description: Model ref for LLM episode summarization, e.g. 'anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5-20251001'. null = rule-based only.

mode.label: Context Engine Mode
mode.help: workspace: use ContextWorkspace with HIDE/ABSTRACT/RECALL tools. legacy: delegate to OpenClaw default engine (baseline comparison).

tokenBudget.label: Token Budget
tokenBudget.help: Maximum tokens for visible context. Blocks are auto-hidden when this is exceeded.

dashboardTopK.label: Dashboard Top-K
dashboardTopK.help: Number of largest blocks shown in the mini dashboard.

summarizerModel.label: Episode Summarizer Model
summarizerModel.help: Model for LLM episode summaries. Format: 'provider/modelId' (e.g. 'anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5-20251001'). Leave empty to use rule-based summaries only.
